proposition: Melvin-Koushki holds that the apologies are the primary source of information about Ibn Turka's life and a uniquely candid record of Timurid religio-political machinations. Set beside his duress warning, this means the apologies are his main biographical witness and, on his own account, a shaped one.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
